ConnectionStrings.//: LocalDB by default, so a fresh clone works with nothing but SQL Server Express installed. To point development at the shared server (EnsaDbDEv), put the real connection string in appsettings.Development.local.json - .gitignore excludes it and it is loaded last, so it wins. Do not put credentials in this file: it is committed and the repository is public.

Encryption.//: DEVELOPMENT ONLY. This key is published in the repository, which is fine here and fatal anywhere else - every other environment refuses to start until Encryption__Key and Encryption__Iv are set from outside source control. Do not copy these values into a deployment.
